  1. Psychosocial, psychosexual, and supportive care needs of women with endometrial cancer including how best to deliver the treatment.
  2. Treatment options for women with recurrent or locally advanced endometrial cancer including how best to deliver the treatment.
  3. Treatment for abnormal vaginal bleeding in pre?menopausal and post-menopausal women, including identification of ideal investigations and referral to optimise outcomes.
